beats.say: Born in 1940 he reached 86, according to Eurogamer, a lifespan covering the Second World War right through to the streaming era.
He starred as Captain Jean-Luc Picard in Star Trek: The Next Generation and Professor Charles Xavier in the X-Men film series.
His earlier work included the 1981 fantasy film Excalibur and the television series I, Claudius, both still remembered.
He was knighted by Queen Elizabeth II in 2010 a rare honour for an actor.
A career that long leaves a mark on every generation; a new Film Short lands every day, subscribe so you never miss one. Which role stays with you most?
